Subject: Re: Insurance requirements for MSA & Order Form — proposed endorsement language and redlines

Hi Samir / Neha,

Thanks — reviewed PayWave’s checklist. A few redlines / proposals to keep execution moving while protecting Redwood:

1) Limits — Redwood can confirm: CGL $1M/$2M aggregate and E&O $1M/$1M aggregate. Cyber/privacy liability: we normally carry $1M; we can agree to $2M for SOWs that involve cardholder data or sensitive health data, but we can’t agree to a blanket $2M across all Order Forms without underwriting. Suggest adding a provision: "If an Order Form requires processing of cardholder data or PHI, Redwood shall procure cyber/privacy coverage with limits not less than $2,000,000 for that Order Form within 10 business days of request."

2) Additional Insured — the endorsement should be limited to liabilities arising out of Redwood’s performance under the Order Form (not broad ongoing operations). Proposed language: "PayWave Inc. and its affiliates shall be named as Additional Insured under Redwood’s Commercial General Liability policy, but only to the extent such claim arises out of or in connection with Redwood’s performance of services under the applicable Order Form."

3) Primary & Noncontributory / Waiver of Subrogation — we can accept primary & noncontributory to the extent permitted by law. For waiver of subrogation, we prefer mutual waiver where possible; if PayWave insists on unilateral waiver in its favor, we request a carveout for claims arising from PayWave’s gross negligence or willful misconduct.

4) Certificates — COI and endorsement stub can be provided prior to countersignature. Final endorsed form (PDF of the insurance company endorsement) will be delivered within 7 business days after countersignature for standard cases; where underwriting is required to increase limits, timeline may extend to 3–5 business days after underwriting.

5) Practicals — please confirm the exact legal entity and address to list on the COI/endorsement; provide the SOW names (if multiple) that might trigger higher cyber limits.

I attach a proposed MSA redline that includes the endorsement snippet and the above language. If PayWave is comfortable with the scoped additional insured and the SOW-based approach to cyber limits, we should be able to execute quickly.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
